question: Can score-based generative models (SMLD) and diffusion models (DDPM) be unified as discretizations of a continuous-time SDE and its reverse-time SDE, enabling new samplers, exact likelihood and controllable generation?
hypothesis: Generalising noise scales to a continuum via SDEs lets score-based models gain better samplers (predictor-corrector, probability flow ODE) and match or beat DDPM quality.
contributions: Flexible sampling and likelihood computation: general SDE solvers, Predictor-Corrector samplers and deterministic probability flow ODE samplers with exact likelihood
Controllable generation: class-conditional, inpainting, colorization from a single unconditional score model
Unified framework: SMLD and DDPM as VE and VP SDE discretizations; new sub-VP SDE; new architectures NCSN++ and DDPM++

method.summary: Data is diffused to a prior by a forward SDE (VE, VP, sub-VP); a time-dependent score network s_theta(x,t) is trained by denoising score matching (Eq. 7) and used in the reverse-time SDE, with PC samplers or a probability flow ODE for sampling and likelihood. Architectures NCSN++ and DDPM++ (DDPM U-Net plus FIR resampling, rescaled skips, BigGAN blocks, more blocks) set CIFAR-10 records.
method.task: unconditional and conditional image generation (CIFAR-10, CelebA, LSUN, CelebA-HQ)

datasets.name: CIFAR-10
datasets.preprocessing: SMLD models normalise inputs to [0,1]; likelihoods on uniformly dequantized data

models.name: NCSN++ / NCSN++ cont. / cont. (deep), VE SDE
models.architecture: DDPM U-Net with FIR up/downsampling, skip rescale 1/sqrt2, BigGAN residual blocks, 4 res blocks per resolution (deep doubles it), progressive 'residual' input

models.name: DDPM++ / cont. / cont. (deep), VP and sub-VP
models.architecture: as NCSN++ but no FIR resampling and no progressive growing; ranked best of 144 configs for VP

models.name: Wide-ResNet-28-10 time-dependent classifier
models.architecture: WRN-28-10, conditioned on log sigma_i via random Fourier features

training.objective: Eq. 7 continuous denoising score matching, lambda(t) proportional to 1/E||grad log p0t||^2, t~U[0,T]; or discrete Eq. 1 (SMLD) / Eq. 3 (DDPM), N=1000 noise scales
training.optimizer: inferred: as Ho et al. (2020); paper says 'follow Ho et al. (2020) for optimization, including the learning rate, gradient clipping, and learning rate warm-up schedules' (values not given)
training.batch_size: 128 on CIFAR-10; 64 on LSUN; 8 on 1024x1024 CelebA-HQ
training.steps: 1.3M iterations (architecture exploration, checkpoint every 50k); 0.95M for cont. models; ~2.4M for CelebA-HQ 1024
training.regularisation: EMA rate 0.999 (VE) / 0.9999 (VP); 0.9999 for CelebA-HQ 1024; fewer iterations (0.95M) to suppress overfitting

other.VE SDE: sigma_min=0.01, sigma_max by Technique 1 of Song&Ermon 2020 (value not given), geometric; epsilon=1e-5
other.VP SDE: beta_min=0.1, beta_max=20, linear; epsilon 1e-3 for sampling, 1e-5 for training/likelihood

inference.decoding: PC sampler: reverse diffusion predictor (Euler-Maruyama for cont. models) + annealed Langevin corrector; or RK45 probability flow ODE (scipy solve_ivp, atol=rtol=1e-5)
inference.samples: Table 1/4: mean and std over five sampling runs; FIDs on 50k samples; NLL averaged over five runs; sampling batch 1024 on CIFAR-10, 8 on LSUN

parameters.snr r (CIFAR-10): grid search step 0.01; best values in Table 5 (e.g. 0.16 VE reverse-diffusion PC1000, 0.01 VP)
parameters.corrector steps: 1 per noise scale for PC; 2 for corrector-only on CIFAR-10
parameters.denoising: single Tweedie denoising step at end of sampling

metrics.name: NLL
metrics.definition: bits/dim on uniformly dequantized CIFAR-10 test set via probability flow ODE and Skilling-Hutchinson trace estimator

limits: Sampling remains slower than GANs; authors call for combining stable learning with fast sampling (Sec 6)
Many sampler hyper-parameters (r, steps, corrector count) need tuning; no method to select them automatically
VE gives better sample quality but worse likelihood than VP/sub-VP; practitioners must try SDEs per domain
1024x1024 CelebA-HQ samples have visible flaws such as facial asymmetry
Compute, hardware, training lr and parameter counts not stated; seeds not stated for training
Probability flow ODE samplers give worse FID than SDE solvers without a corrector, especially for VE

terms.definition: Variance Exploding SDE, continuous limit of SMLD noise perturbation (Eq. 9)
Variance Preserving SDE, continuous limit of DDPM (Eq. 11)
new SDE (Eq. 12) whose variance is always bounded by the VP SDE's
numerical reverse-SDE step as predictor, then score-based MCMC (Langevin) as corrector
deterministic process whose trajectories share the same marginals as the SDE (Eq. 13)
